title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented University Libraries study environments across East Bank, West Bank, and the Saint Paul campus.

cards.title: Walter Library 206
cards.subtitle: Walter Library · East Bank
cards.notes: Use the mix of tables, chairs, and individual desks to switch between solo reading and a small working session.
cards.short_summary: A large East Bank open-study area with natural light and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Walter Library 206 is an open study space with capacity 172, natural light, tables and chairs, individual desks, and a low-hum noise level.
cards.source_title: Walter Library 206 | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Walter Library building hours.

cards.title: Walter Library Sub-basement Floor
cards.subtitle: Walter Library · East Bank
cards.notes: Settle into the tables or lounge seating in the stacks when you need a quiet setting for reading or written work.
cards.short_summary: Quiet open study seating among Walter Library’s stacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Walter Library’s sub-basement is an open study space with tables, chairs, lounge seating, capacity 30, and a quiet noise level.
cards.source_title: Walter Library - Sub-basement floor | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Walter Library building hours.

cards.title: Walter Library 204F
cards.subtitle: Walter Library · East Bank
cards.notes: Reserve this four-person glass-walled room when your group needs a whiteboard and an enclosed place to work together.
cards.short_summary: A reservable four-person group room with a fixed whiteboard.
cards.evidence_claim: Walter Library 204F is a reservable study room for four with natural light, tables and chairs, a fixed whiteboard, and a low-hum noise level.
cards.source_title: Walter Library 204F | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; a U Card is required for library access.

cards.title: Wilson Library Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Wilson Library · West Bank
cards.notes: Choose a table, chair, or lounge seat and keep the session quiet; the listed area supports a range of seating styles.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, high-capacity Wilson Library study area with lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson Library’s second-floor open study space has capacity 100, tables and chairs, lounge seating, and a quiet noise level.
cards.source_title: Wilson Library - 2nd floor | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Wilson Library building hours.

cards.title: Wilson Library Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Wilson Library · West Bank
cards.notes: Bring reading or laptop work to the fourth floor and use its naturally lit tables, chairs, or lounge seating.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, naturally lit fourth-floor study area.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson Library’s fourth-floor open study space has capacity 20, natural light, tables and chairs, lounge seating, and a quiet noise level.
cards.source_title: Wilson Library - 4th floor | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Wilson Library building hours.

cards.title: Wilson Library 301B
cards.subtitle: Wilson Library · West Bank
cards.notes: Plan an unplugged reading session here: the room is designated deep quiet, with no laptop or cell-phone use.
cards.short_summary: A naturally lit, device-free deep-quiet room for individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson Library 301B is an open study space for individual study with a large window, tables and chairs, natural light, and a quiet noise level; laptops and cell phones are not allowed.
cards.source_title: Wilson Library 301B | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations. Do not use laptops or cell phones in this space.

cards.title: Wilson Research Collaboration Studio
cards.subtitle: Wilson Library · West Bank
cards.notes: Bring a project group and use the mobile whiteboards and display monitors to map ideas, share screens, or review drafts.
cards.short_summary: An open collaborative space with whiteboards, displays, and large windows.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wilson Research Collaboration Studio is an open study space for collaborative and group work with mobile whiteboards, mobile and fixed display monitors, natural light, and capacity 60.
cards.source_title: Wilson Library - Research Collaboration Studio | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Wilson Library building hours.

cards.title: Wilson Library 423
cards.subtitle: Wilson Library · West Bank
cards.notes: Reserve this single-person room when you need an individual desk, natural light, and a quieter enclosed study setting.
cards.short_summary: A reservable one-person study room on Wilson’s fourth floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wilson Library 423 is a reservable, quiet study room for one with natural light and an individual desk.
cards.source_title: Wilson Library 423 | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservation is required; a U Card is required for library access.

cards.title: Magrath Library First Floor
cards.subtitle: Magrath Library · Saint Paul Campus
cards.notes: Use the first-floor carrels, tables, or soft seating for individual work, then shift seats if your task changes.
cards.short_summary: Naturally lit Saint Paul campus seating for individual or group quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Magrath Library’s first-floor open study space has capacity 15, natural light, tables and chairs, individual desks, and a low-hum noise level.
cards.source_title: Magrath Library - 1st floor | University of Minnesota Libraries
cards.access_notes: A U Card is required to access University of Minnesota Libraries locations; use during Magrath Library building hours.

cards.title: Health Sciences Education Center Room 5-105
cards.subtitle: Health Sciences Education Center · East Bank
cards.notes: Arrive during building hours and select furniture that fits the task; movable whiteboards, wireless access, and power are available.
cards.short_summary: A first-come, first-served quiet study area with flexible furniture.
cards.evidence_claim: Health Sciences Education Center room 5-105 is a large open quiet-study area available first come, first served during building hours, with movable whiteboards, wireless access, and power.
cards.access_notes: Available first come, first served during building hours; a U Card is required for University of Minnesota library access.
